subject: Integracom MAP: integration checkpoints & owner assignments
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <anguyen@integracom.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integracom MAP: integration checkpoints & timelines

Hi team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Integracom is excited to move the MAP forward. Attached is a light first-draft MAP (Integracom_MAP_v1.pdf) that combines our evaluation plan and proposed close timeline.

Top-level asks for this week:
- Confirm owners for integration tracks (SDK / API, Auth, Streaming, Tool-calling).
- Share any major blockers (security/compliance items we should surface to Integracom SOC).
- Confirm evaluation dataset and the pilot window (we'd like a short live pilot before committing).

Key dates in our draft:
- Evaluation window start: 2026-10-01
- Production pilot target: 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-03
- Contract close target: 2026-11-05

SDK / integration-specific notes:
- Integracom will need streaming + tool-calling for the customer-facing agent.
- Auth must support OIDC + SCIM for user sync (they use Okta).
- They prefer a small initial SDK in Node with a Go follow-up.

Can each of you reply with owner confirmation and a 1–2 line readiness note by EOD 2026-09-15? I know this is tight but Integracom is pushing the timeline.

Attachments: Integracom_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, Integracom
anguyen@integracom.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <anguyen@integracom.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integracom MAP: integration checkpoints & timelines

Alex — thanks for the clear draft and timeline. Short answers and owners below; I created a concise action list so Integracom has one place to reference. I also added a short SDK plan (sdk-integration-plan.xlsx) — internal link attached.

Action items (owners + next steps):
- SDK / API integration: Monica Patel — deliver Node SDK prototype + example app by 2026-09-29 (PR link to follow).
- Auth (OIDC + SCIM): Diego Fernandez — capture gap analysis vs. Integracom Okta setup; target doc + small spike by 2026-09-24.
- Streaming (low-latency channel): Grace Oconnor — validate streaming path and perf targets; short perf test plan by 2026-09-22.
- Tool-calling / Function hooks: Karthik Iyer — define function schema and failure modes; deliver proto contract by 2026-09-23.

Risks / blockers to flag for Integracom:
- SCIM bulk provisioning edge cases (Diego to enumerate).
- Streaming throughput at 500 concurrent sessions (Grace to run a scaled test).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/Integracom/D-2026-00471
GitHub PR template (internal): https://github.com/integracom/redwood-sdk-integ/pull/27

Attachments: sdk-integration-plan.xlsx

I'll run weekly MAP checkpoints every Tuesday at 10am PT; first sync: 2026-09-22 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integracom MAP: integration checkpoints & timelines — SDK update

Karthik — quick status update on the SDK track:

What I did:
- Initial Node SDK scaffold completed, includes auth helper and streaming client wrapper.
- Opened PR: https://github.com/integracom/redwood-sdk-integ/pull/27 (WIP).
- Wrote a short README with example server and sample prompt sets for Integracom evaluation.

Next steps / asks:
- Need Diego to confirm any special auth header transforms for Okta SCIM flow (I stubbed a token exchange flow).
- I'll add a small example for tool-calling in the sample app once Karthik posts the proto contract.

ETA: aiming to have a review-ready PR by 2026-09-21; if we get a quick code review we can cut the Node package and share the example app for Integracom to test during the eval window.

Attachment: auth-design.md (notes on token flow and exchange)

- Monica
Monica Patel
SDK Lead, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Alex Nguyen <anguyen@integracom.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integracom MAP: integration checkpoints & timelines — confirm

Team — really appreciate the quick responses and owner assignments. Confirming Integracom is aligned on the proposed dates: evaluation start 2026-10-01 and pilot window 2026-10-20.

Please proceed with the owner deliverables as listed by Karthik. A few notes from our side:
- We'll provision a sandbox Okta tenant for testing SCIM and will share access by 2026-09-20.
- For the streaming test, we'll provide a sample traffic generator so you can validate concurrency.
- We expect the first evaluation pass to be functional (end-to-end) rather than performance-optimized; we will reserve performance validation for the pilot window.

I'll accept the calendar invite for 2026-09-22 10:00 PT. After that sync, if all looks good, we'll lock the evaluation dataset and add the official SOW placeholder (DocuSign link below) for legal to start a preliminary review.

DocuSign SOW (placeholder): https://app.hellosign.com/s/placeholder-sow

Thanks — Alex
Alex Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, Integracom
anguyen@integracom.com
